exposure: High-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) combined with suction curettage
cohort: 41 patients diagnosed with exogenous cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
finding: High-intensity focused ultrasound combined with suction curettage is an effective treatment for exogenous CSP of less than 9 weeks gestation, with gestational sac size and myometrium thickness between the bladder and gestational sac identified as potential risk factors for bleeding.
